description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [100% Critical 2] to the user if 0-1 of Laguna and Ward are alive, grants [100% Critical (15s)] to all allies if both Laguna and Ward are alive, grants [Awoken Laguna Aide], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Switch Draw Mode (Ice, Dark)] to the user

description.name: Awoken Laguna Aide
description.text: Ice and Dark abilities don't consume uses, Ice and Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Pain Thrust after using Dark or Ice abilities

description.name: Switch Draw Mode (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Dark] after using a Ice/Dark ability
